The save path runs from the chart's lab-results form through `openmrsFetch` to the `fulfillerdetails` sub-resource, then through `OrderServiceImpl` into Hibernate.

1. **Frontend request:** `updateOrderFulfillerDetails` in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/lab-results/lab-results.resource.ts:327-336`. It POSTs the payload to `${restBaseUrl}/order/${orderUuid}/fulfillerdetails/`. Its callers are `updateOrderResult` (lines 278-296, which saves the encounter first, then the fulfiller details) and `completeOrderWithSavedResults` (lines 302-325, which sometimes discontinues the order first). The form sets `fulfillerStatus: 'COMPLETED'` and `fulfillerComment` around `exported-lab-results-form.workspace.tsx:246-247`.
2. **Server REST handler:** `FulfillerDetailsResource2_3.save` in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs2_3/FulfillerDetailsResource2_3.java:43-48`. It calls `Context.getOrderService().updateOrderFulfillerStatus(...)` with status, comment and accession number. This is the 2_3 sub-resource, which is the one the chart's unversioned path resolves to. I did not confirm the version routing.
3. **Core service:** `OrderServiceImpl.updateOrderFulfillerStatus` (4-argument) in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/OrderServiceImpl.java:553-570`. It sets the status and comment on the order and calls `saveOrderInternal`, which is at lines 350-379 and ends in `dao.saveOrder`.
4. **Data access:** `HibernateOrderDAO.saveOrder` in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateOrderDAO.java:92-95`. It calls `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate` on the current Hibernate session.

The interface declarations are `OrderService.updateOrderFulfillerStatus` (line 391-392) and `OrderDAO.saveOrder` (line 47). The `laboratory-app` repo has its own equivalent in `laboratory.resource.ts:112-131`, but that is outside the patient chart, so I left it out of the ranking.
